structureOrder.alt: Production AI system flow A request passes through identity and policy, routing, context construction, model inference, and validation. Validation returns a response or sends a tool proposal to authorization and execution. Tool results return to context. Authorized data, caches, and tool contracts feed context. Observability watches the operating path, while evaluations improve it.

From model response to verified outcome The mainline path inspects the response state and continues only when the response is usable. It parses the payload, validates its raw structure, applies only allowed normalization, revalidates the schema and domain invariants, authorizes the exact action, executes or publishes, and verifies the postcondition. Refused or incomplete responses do not proceed to parsing.

Graceful fallback path for eligible failures An eligible failure moves from the primary qualified model to a contract-compatible secondary provider or model. A further eligible failure may move to a disclosed read-only or lower-capability mode. From there the system returns a deterministic result, queues the work, or hands it to a human. Safety refusals, authorization or policy denials, and semantic validation failures do not enter this chain.

Retrieval-augmented generation dataflow The ingestion lane preserves source structure, authorizes and versions chunks, and writes lexical and vector indexes to a shared datastore. In the query lane, identity-based tenant and document filters converge with that shared index before candidate retrieval. Candidates are fused, reranked, deduplicated, and packed into context before the system either answers with claim-level citations or abstains.
